nodes.description: Public timestamp after which the last bidder can claim the pot; extended by incoming bids.
Accumulated pot balance held by the contract, excluding the current bid's fee.
Fee divisor initialized to 10, meaning a 10% developer fee on every bid.
Hardcoded developer address that receives the fee portion of every bid.
Address of the most recent eligible bidder, eligible to receive the pot.
Payable constructor: initializes lastBidder, kBalance, timeOut and feeRate.
Payable fallback: takes bids, pays the fee, extends the timer and pays the previous winner.
Caller-controlled address used as bidder, as lastBidder and as payout recipient.
now is used for timeout comparisons and for computing timer extensions.
External ETH transfer sending the computed fee to the hardcoded developer address.
External ETH transfer paying the previous winner before kBalance and lastBidder are updated.
Integer division computing the fee from msg.value and feeRate.
Integer arithmetic dividing by _val to derive the timer extension; unsafe for tiny or zero net bids.
Local holding the fee amount deducted from msg.value.
Local holding the net bid amount after the fee is deducted.

edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to establish the initial bidder.
msg.sender is written into lastBidder in both the constructor and the fallback.
Constructor initializes the lastBidder state variable.
Constructor sets timeOut to now + 10 minutes.
Constructor sets kBalance from msg.value.
timeOut is derived from and later compared against block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
Fallback executes the fee division at the start of a bid.
feeRate is the divisor of msg.value in the fee computation.
Fallback performs an external ETH transfer of the fee.
TechnicalRise is the fixed recipient of the fee transfer.
Fallback performs an external payout to lastBidder while state is still stale.
lastBidder determines the payout recipient and is only updated after the transfer.
kBalance is read to compute the payout before being reset, enabling re-entrant draining.
Attacker-controlled msg.sender can become lastBidder and re-enter during the payout transfer.
Timer extension arithmetic depends on block.timestamp values.
timeOut is read and incremented by the timer extension arithmetic.
Fallback divides by _val when extending the timer, unsafe for very small bids.
Fallback mutates timeOut on small bids, timeout payouts and timer extensions.
Fallback mutates kBalance as bids accumulate and payouts occur.
Fallback reassigns lastBidder to the new msg.sender.
_val is the divisor of the timer extension, so a near-zero net bid causes a huge value or division by zero.
The division result is stored in the local _fee.
_fee is the amount passed to the TechnicalRise transfer.
_val is used to compute the payout kBalance - _val before state is updated.

normalization_plan.reason: _fee is a transient local that only holds the result of the fee division and should be folded into the arithmetic operation producing it.
_val is the transient net-bid local that is directly consumed as the divisor of the timer extension arithmetic.
